name: Wavelength (Lightning Labs)
summary: Lightning Labs' self-custodial Bitcoin wallet toolkit (Ark, Lightning swaps, on-chain) with an MCP server and L402 so agents can pay and get paid per request.
description: One daemon (`waved`) plus CLI (`wavecli`) combines an Ark client, a Lightning swap engine and an on-chain wallet, with gRPC/REST APIs, Go SDKs and web/React/React Native SDKs (WebAssembly runtime). `wavecli mcp serve` exposes the wallet to agents as typed MCP tools; `wavecli bakemacaroon` issues least-privilege macaroons (e.g. receive-only, cannot sign or recover). Seeds and passwords stay on the command line, not the agent channel; users can unilaterally exit to the Bitcoin chain. Live on mainnet since 2026-10-23 (still labelled alpha): up to 300,000 sats per account and 50,000 sats per VTXO; Lightning sends and receives carry a 0.25% service fee plus routing fees; funds need a free automatic refresh about every two weeks. Agent docs at llms.txt/llms-full.txt; skills via `npx skills add lightninglabs/wavelength-sdk`. Stablecoins announced as coming soon.

agent_access.notes: Local MCP via `wavecli mcp serve`; access is controlled with macaroons from the user's own daemon. Usage fees as described (0.25% Lightning service fee, on-chain fees).
